extraction_notes: This is a family datasheet; the 1SMA4733A row was selected from the 1SMA4728A through 1SMA4764A electrical-characteristics table for manufacturer hongjiacheng (Zhuhai Hongjiacheng Technology co., Ltd.).
The supplied PDF identity was verified as LCSC C19077476, MPN 1SMA4733A, manufacturer hongjiacheng, with SHA-256 a66d0e20d37b19b6776d33e5d234d792d89e30813774a7dde79429c97d6773dd.

Zener reverse semantics are preserved: nominal VZ = 5.1 V is paired with the tabulated reverse test current IZT = 49 mA; maximum ZZT = 7.0 ohm is at IZT. The row also gives minimum VZ = 4.84 V, maximum VZ = 5.36 V, maximum reverse leakage IR = 10 microA at VR = 1 V, and admissible IZM = 186 mA, all at TA = 25 degC unless otherwise noted.

No component-specific usable curve was extracted. Page 3 Fig. 2 shows only VZ = 25 V, 30 V, 65 V, and 91 V traces, not the exact 5.1 V target; Fig. 3 is a generic forward characteristic without an exact 1SMA4733A trace. No capacitance or reverse-recovery-time data is published.
Page 1 maximum ratings also specify PD = 1000 mW at Tc = 75 degC, junction and storage temperature limits of -55 to +150 degC, and typical RthetaJ-A = 250 degC/W.
extraction.omission_reason: The supplied PDF contains no component-specific usable curve for 1SMA4733A: page 3 Fig. 2 contains only 25 V, 30 V, 65 V, and 91 V zener traces, while Fig. 3 is a generic forward characteristic without an exact 5.1 V trace; capacitance and reverse-recovery curves are also absent.

current.conditions: Conservative F1 package bench at 95% of the cited current; IF = 200 mA, TA = 25 degC
